steps.text: Welcome, {name}. Every action uses up years of a short life: a hunt takes 2. Begin with a Hunt for XP, gold and loot.
{name} is badly hurt. Rest heals fully for 1 year; a potion heals at once, for gold.
Train a stat for a lasting bonus: STR hits harder, MAG casts stronger, AGI is quicker, VIT is tougher. Takes 2 years.
{name} can found a family now. Children inherit traits and carry the house on when {name} is gone.
A family needs age {min_age}. Until then, hunt, train and earn gold. Children carry the house on.
The house is founded. Hunt on, then Retire to hand it to a child. If {name} dies first, a child inherits anyway.
Pick the child who carries the house on. Some traits pass down, some lie dormant. A lower Fate Value means fewer failures.
{name} stands in the open world. Walk about: the land, its trees and its creatures are the same in every life.
Dig down for ore: the deeper, the older and richer the ground. What you dig goes to the house's stores.
Building takes oak. Trees give it: tell a companion to Gather near a wood and the stores fill.
You have the oak for a wall. Build on the family's ground, within {claim} tiles of {home}.
Walls that close a space make a room. Leave one out for a door: it needs a wall on each side.
Companions follow {name}. Tell one to Stay, Gather or Guard and they work while you roam.
Night. Wolves and worse see further in the dark and come in greater numbers. Fog hides you both.
